name: Fourteen Years of Flames
storyline: Fenghuo Fourteen is a story set against the backdrop of the fourteen years of war, offering players a chance to return to the battlefields of the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression from a Chinese perspective. Experience once again the smoke of war that engulfed 400 million people in those turbulent years, a time when the entire nation stood united in its struggle for survival.
summary: Fourteen Years of Flames is a story-driven FPS that replays China’s struggle in the Second Sino-Japanese War (1931–1945). Players embody 7 key characters and battle through 16 real historical events, experiencing the hardships and sacrifices over 14 years of struggle. Land weeps in 14 years of war.
